units.source_text: 一条院的落叶公主不得与丈夫见最后一面，就此永别，自然倍感悲伤。

en.t: Princess Ochiba of Ichijo-in was not able to see her husband one last time before they were parted forever, and naturally she was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 日子渐久，广大的邸宅内仆从陆续散去，人数稀少，冷落萧条，只有柏木生前几个亲信的人，有时还来慰问。

en.t: As the days passed, the servants in the spacious residence gradually drifted away, leaving it thinly staffed, desolate, and neglected; only a few of Kashiwagi's close attendants from his lifetime still came now and then to offer comfort.

units.source_text: 管理柏木所爱好的鹰和马的人，失却了依靠，垂头丧气地进进出出，落叶公主每次看到，都有无限感慨。

en.t: The men who had looked after the hawks and horses Kashiwagi loved had lost their patron and went in and out with downcast faces; whenever Princess Ochiba saw them, she was filled with endless emotion.

units.source_text: 柏木生前惯用的器物，依然存在。

en.t: The objects Kashiwagi had used habitually in life were still there.

units.source_text: 常弹的琵琶与和琴，弦线已经脱落，默默无声地搁着，教人看了实在伤心！

en.t: The biwa and wagon he had often played lay silently where they were, their strings already fallen slack or come loose, and the sight was truly heartbreaking.

units.source_text: 只有庭前的树木，依旧绿烟笼罩，群花不忘春来，到处含苞欲放。

en.t: Only the trees before the garden remained wrapped in green haze as before, while the many flowers, not forgetting the coming of spring, were budding everywhere and ready to bloom.

units.source_text: 落叶公主怅望此景，不胜悲戚。

en.t: Princess Ochiba gazed sadly at this scene and could not bear the weight of her sorrow.

units.source_text: 众侍女穿着淡墨色的丧服，寂寞无聊地度送春昼。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting wore pale ink-colored mourning robes and passed the spring days in lonely idleness.
